title: Annotatio V §.IX open: Tertia Probatio — denying Oral = denying Communion of Saints
pass_a_gloss: §. IX. The Author’s Third Proof had imputed to those denying Oral Eating a negation of the Communion of Saints, handed down yet in the Christians’ common Symbol, or the Apostolic; thus easily about to prove that a Fundamental article is being disputed while the saw of Disputation is reciprocated about Oral Eating. But when I had retorted: That the Communion of Saints is hardly caused by oral eating, unless we also wish the impious mixed into this Communion no less than the pious and holy, who on the Lutheran hypothesis eat Oraliter.
pass_b_english: §.IX: third proof — denying Oral is charged as denying the Communion of Saints in the Apostles’ Creed, hence a fundamental article.
Strimesius had retorted: oral eating does not cause that Communion unless the impious are mixed in with the holy — since on the Lutheran hypothesis the unworthy also eat orally.
source_text: §. IX. Tertia Autoris Probatio, Negantibus Oralem Manducationem, Communionis Sanctorum negationem imputaverat, Symbolo tamen Christianorum communi, seu Apostolicô traditæ; sic facilè evictura, de Fundamentali articulo disceptari, dum de Orali Manducatione serra Disputationis reciprocature. Quando verò ego regesseram: Communionem Sanctorum orali manducatione haud causari, nisi & impios Communioni huic immisceri velimus, non minus ac pios sanctósque, ex hypothesi Lutherana, Oraliter manducantes.

lemmas.gloss: negation of the Communion of Saints
the impious mixed into this Communion
